title: Cadence: Strategic Guidance for Coding Agents
title_zh: Cadence:战略指导方针 for Coding Agents

paragraphs.en: Runtime monitors are increasingly used to improve the reliability of LLM-based coding agents by inspecting execution trajectories and delivering corrective guidance upon detecting misbehavior. However, their effectiveness remains limited by static guidance triggering schemes. Existing monitors rely either on fixed inspection intervals, missing timely guidance during severe misbehaviors while incurring unnecessary overhead during healthy execution, or on rigid heuristic rules, failing to detect complex reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we propose Cadence, a dynamic monitoring framework that adaptively schedules inspections and delivers guidance according to the agent’s real-time execution health. Cadence consists of two core modules: a two-tier intervention module and an inspection scheduler. The intervention module delivers advisory-level guidance for normal executions and minor lapses, while providing replacement-level guidance for severe misbehaviors. Driven by the intervention level, the scheduler adjusts the inspection frequency by tightening supervision after replacement-level guidance and relaxing it after advisory-level guidance. Evaluated on 300 SWE-bench Lite tasks across two distinct agents, mini-swe-agent and Moatless, Cadence achieves the highest resolve rate among all evaluated monitors. Specifically, Cadence outperforms vanilla agents by 25.33% (+76 resolved tasks) on mini-swe-agent and 15.67% (+47 resolved tasks) on Moatless, while maintaining competitive token efficiency compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时监控器正被越来越多地用于提升基于大型语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体的可靠性，通过检查执行轨迹并在检测到异常行为时提供纠正性指导。 然而，其有效性仍受到静态指导触发机制的限制。 现有的监控器要么依赖固定的检查间隔，导致在严重异常行为发生时无法及时提供指导，而在正常执行期间却产生不必要的开销；要么依赖僵化的启发式规则，因而无法检测复杂的推理错误。 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 Cadence——一个动态监控框架，能够根据智能体的实时执行状态自适应地安排检查并提供指导。 Cadence 由两个核心模块组成：一个两级干预模块和一个检查调度器。 干预模块在正常执行和轻微失误时提供建议级指导，而在严重异常行为发生时则提供替换级指导。 根据干预级别，调度器会调整检查频率：在提供替换级指导后加强监督，在提供建议级指导后则放松监督。 在两个不同智能体（mini-swe-agent 和 Moatless）的 300 个 SWE-bench Lite 任务上进行评估后，Cadence 在所有受测监控器中实现了最高的解决率。 具体而言，Cadence 在 mini-swe-agent 上的表现比基础智能体提升了 25.33%（多解决了 76 项任务），在 Moatless 上提升了 15.67%（多解决了 47 项任务），同时与当前最先进的基线方法相比，其令牌效率仍具有竞争力。

paragraphs.en: To improve coding agents, existing work examines step-by-step agent trajectories and provides guidance to prevent error actions. This work can be divided into two categories based on the stage of guidance: offline learning and online monitoring . Offline learning relies on historical execution records to post-train the agent’s backbone model ( Wei et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , or to construct a memory bank as a domain knowledge base ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Hayashi et al., 2025 ) . However, these offline methods cannot intervene during test-time execution once an agent deviates. In contrast, runtime monitors inspect the agent’s intermediate execution trace on-the-fly and inject guidance to correct misbehavior ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Nanda et al., 2026 ) . Recent studies show that early mistakes propagate into cascading failures, making dynamic intervention essential to catch errors before they become unrecoverable ( Pan et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了改进编码智能体，现有研究通过考察智能体的分步轨迹并提供指导来防止错误操作。 根据指导阶段的不同，这项研究可分为两类：离线学习和在线监控。 离线学习依赖历史执行记录对智能体的主干模型进行后训练（Wei et al., 2025；Pan et al., 2025a；Yang et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026），或构建一个记忆库作为领域知识库（Chen et al., 2026a；Zhao et al., 2024；Hayashi et al., 2025）。 然而，一旦智能体在执行过程中偏离正轨，这些离线方法便无法在测试阶段进行干预。 相比之下，运行时监控器能够实时检查智能体的中间执行轨迹，并注入指导以纠正不当行为（Liu et al., 2026；Nanda et al., 2026）。 近期研究表明，早期的错误会引发连锁故障，因此动态干预对于在错误变得不可挽回之前将其捕获至关重要（Pan et al., 2025b；Zhang et al., 2024a；Huang et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Runtime monitoring approaches deploy a dedicated monitor to supervise the execution trajectory of a coding agent. By inspecting ongoing execution steps, the monitor identifies misbehaviors (i.e., error steps), and injects corrective guidance into the coding agent’s context. A central challenge is deciding when the monitor should deliver this guidance . Existing approaches fall into two categories: 1) periodic guidance , which inspects progress at fixed step intervals, then prompts corrective instructions into the context ( Nanda et al., 2026 ) ; and 2) rule-based guidance , which triggers on predefined heuristic rules to catch specific error patterns. When patterns appear, the monitor intervenes with operational guidance tailored to the matching failure ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 运行时监控方法会部署一个专用监控器，以监督编码智能体的执行轨迹。 通过检查正在进行的执行步骤，监控器能够识别异常行为（即错误步骤），并将纠正性指导注入编码智能体的上下文中。 一个核心挑战是决定监控器应在何时提供这种指导。 现有方法可分为两类：1）周期性指导，即在固定的步骤间隔内检查进展，然后将纠正性指令提示到上下文中（Nanda et al., 2026）；以及 2）基于规则的指导，即根据预定义的启发式规则触发，以捕捉特定的错误模式。 当出现这些模式时，监控器会针对匹配的错误提供量身定制的操作指导进行干预（Liu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Our preliminary study shows that neither of these static trigger mechanisms delivers guidance properly. Rule-based guidance overlooks reasoning errors, which manifest in natural language and follow no fixed misbehavior patterns. Periodic guidance, in contrast, oscillates between over-guidance and under-guidance . When the coding agent only encounters minor lapses, frequent interventions add unnecessary overhead (over-guidance). Conversely, when the coding agent enters severe failure actions (e.g., repeating an invalid patch), sparse guidance fails to correct the misbehavior before it compounds irreversibly (under-guidance).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的初步研究表明，这两种静态触发机制都无法正确提供指导。 基于规则的指导会忽略推理错误，而这些错误在自然语言中表现多样，并无固定的异常行为模式。 相比之下，周期性指导会在过度指导和不足指导之间来回摆动。 当编码智能体仅遇到轻微失误时，频繁干预会增加不必要的负担（过度指导）。 反之，当编码智能体进入严重故障状态（例如重复应用无效的补丁）时，稀疏指导无法在问题不可逆转地恶化之前纠正异常行为（不足指导）。

paragraphs.en: To address this, we argue that monitors must move beyond rigid schedules and simple rules and instead provide strategic guidance : an LLM-based monitoring policy that decides both when to inspect and how to intervene based on the agent’s runtime execution health. Rather than treating inspection and intervention as separate decisions, strategic guidance unifies them, dynamically tuning the inspection frequency while delivering context-aware interventions tailored to the agent’s evolving health status.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们认为，监控机制必须超越僵化的时间表和简单的规则，转而提供战略指导：一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的监控策略，该策略会根据智能体运行时的执行健康状况，决定何时进行检查以及如何进行干预。 战略指导将检查与干预视为统一的整体，而非相互独立的决策，从而动态调整检查频率，同时提供能够感知上下文、针对智能体不断变化的健康状况量身定制的干预措施。

paragraphs.en: Guided by this principle, we propose Cadence, a holistic runtime monitoring framework for coding agents that synergizes adaptive inspection scheduling with a two-tier intervention mechanism. The first module is a two-tier intervention module , which evaluates agent’s recent execution health and applies an intervention at the appropriate level: advisory or replacement . When the coding agent stays on track or exhibits minor lapses, an advisory-level intervention provides lightweight guidance while allowing the current step to proceed. When severe misbehaviors occur, a replacement-level intervention discards the erroneous step and prompts the agent to regenerate an alternative action. The second module is an inspection scheduler , which dynamically adjusts the inspection frequency based on the first module’s output. Using the resulting intervention level as a direct signal of execution health, it extends the inspection interval upon an advisory intervention to reduce monitoring overhead, but resets the interval to a base value upon a replacement intervention to enforce close oversight. Together, these modules allow Cadence to adaptively balance intervention effectiveness while limiting unnecessary monitoring burden.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一原则，我们提出了 Cadence——一个面向编码智能体的整体运行时监控框架，它将自适应检查调度与双层级干预机制协同结合。 第一个模块是双层级干预模块，用于评估智能体近期的执行健康状况，并在适当层级实施干预：建议级或替换级。 当编码智能体保持正常运行或仅出现轻微偏差时，建议级干预会提供轻量级指导，同时允许当前步骤继续执行。 当发生严重异常行为时，替换级干预会丢弃错误步骤，并提示智能体重新生成替代动作。 第二个模块是检查调度器，它会根据第一个模块的输出动态调整检查频率。 它将产生的干预层级作为执行健康状况的直接信号：若为建议级干预，则延长检查间隔以降低监控开销；若为替换级干预，则将间隔重置为基准值以确保密切监督。 这些模块协同工作，使 Cadence 能够在提升干预效果的同时，限制不必要的监控负担。

sents.en: Using the resulting intervention level as a direct signal of execution health, it extends the inspection interval upon an advisory intervention to reduce monitoring overhead, but resets the interval to a base value upon a replacement intervention to enforce close oversight.
sents.zh: 它将产生的干预层级作为执行健康状况的直接信号：若为建议级干预，则延长检查间隔以降低监控开销；若为替换级干预，则将间隔重置为基准值以确保密切监督。

sents.en: Together, these modules allow Cadence to adaptively balance intervention effectiveness while limiting unnecessary monitoring burden.
sents.zh: 这些模块协同工作，使 Cadence 能够在提升干预效果的同时，限制不必要的监控负担。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate Cadence for autonomous bug-fixing agents, though its strategic guidance mechanism generalizes to broader coding tasks because it does not rely on task-specific heuristics. We comprehensively evaluate Cadence on SWE-bench Lite ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) across different scaffolds and backbones. Our results show that Cadence consistently outperforms existing runtime monitors, improving the task resolve rate by 25.33% (+76 resolved tasks) over the unmonitored baselines in mini-swe-agent, and 15.67% (+47 tasks) in Moatless. Furthermore, Cadence demonstrates competitive token efficiency against existing monitors, reducing average total tokens per task to 0.48M on Moatless and 1.03M on mini-swe-agent, compared with 0.51M and 1.47M for state-of-the-art monitor.

paragraphs.en: To sum up, the main contributions of this paper are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，本文的主要贡献有三点：

paragraphs.en: We conduct a preliminary study on existing runtime monitors and find that rule-based guidance misses reasoning errors that follow no fixed pattern, while periodic guidance oscillates between over-guidance and under-guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对现有的运行时监控器进行了初步研究，发现基于规则的指导会遗漏那些没有固定模式的推理错误，而周期性指导则会在过度指导和不足指导之间摇摆不定。

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, we propose Cadence, the first runtime monitor that strategically inspects and guides coding agents, by combining a two-tier intervention module and an inspection scheduler to adjust inspection frequency according to the agent’s execution health.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，我们提出了 Cadence——首个运行时监控器，它通过结合双层干预模块和检查调度器，根据智能体的执行健康状况调整检查频率，从而对编码智能体进行策略性检查和引导。

paragraphs.en: We comprehensively evaluate Cadence on SWE-bench Lite, showing that Cadence improves resolve rates by up to 25.33% over vanilla coding agents while achieving up to 29.93% token savings compared with state-of-the-art monitors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SWE-bench Lite 上对 Cadence 进行了全面评估，结果表明，与基础编码智能体相比，Cadence 的解决率最高提升了 25.33%，同时与当前最先进的监控器相比，实现了高达 29.93% 的 token 节省。

paragraphs.en: Existing runtime monitors deliver guidance through static triggers, relying on either fixed inspection intervals or predefined heuristic rules. In this section, we empirically examine the limitations of both mechanisms on SWE-bench Lite.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的运行时监控器通过静态触发器提供指导，依赖固定的检查间隔或预定义的启发式规则。 在本节中，我们将在 SWE-bench Lite 上实证检验这两种机制的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Existing monitors with periodic guidance focus on refining prompts to detect agent misbehaviors, while simply adopting a fixed inspection interval. To investigate the impact of such periodic guidance on agent performance, we implement a basic fixed-interval monitor over the mini-swe-agent framework. In this study, the underlying coding agent employs GPT-5-mini as its backbone, whereas the monitor utilizes GPT-5.2. At each inspection point, the monitor prompts an LLM to inspect the problem description and the agent’s recent execution trajectory, generating targeted guidance that is appended to the agent’s context for subsequent execution.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的周期性指导监控器专注于优化提示词以检测智能体的异常行为，但仅采用固定的检查间隔。 为了研究此类周期性指导对智能体性能的影响，我们在 mini-swe-agent 框架上部署了一种基础固定间隔监控器。 在本研究中，底层的编码智能体使用 GPT-5-mini 作为其核心模型，而监控器则使用 GPT-5.2。 在每个检查点，监控器会提示一个大型语言模型检查问题描述和智能体的近期执行轨迹，生成针对性指导，并将其附加到智能体的上下文中以用于后续执行。

paragraphs.en: To examine how inspection frequency interacts with agent runtime behavior, we partition SWE-bench Lite into two distinct groups based on the outcome of the vanilla (i.e., without monitoring) mini-swe-agent: 145 resolved tasks and 155 unresolved tasks. The resolved group represents scenarios where the agent stays on track or recovers from minor lapses autonomously. In contrast, the unresolved group reflects compromised execution health, where the agent suffers from severe misbehaviors that compound into irrecoverable failure.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four distinct inspection intervals, namely 3, 5, 9, and 15 steps, plotting the resolve rate against the interval for each group in Figure 1 . As the inspection interval increases, the resolve rate exhibits opposing trends between the two groups. For the group with compromised execution health, a larger interval degrades performance, dropping the resolve rate from 23.87% at interval 3 to 14.19% at interval 15, representing a severe 9.68% decline. In contrast, for the group with favorable execution health, the resolve rate consistently remains high across all interval settings, staying at or above 88.28%. Meanwhile, increasing the interval from 3 to 15 monotonically reduces token consumption in both groups, moving from 0.45M to 0.30M tokens for the resolved group and from 0.70M to 0.49M tokens for the unresolved group. These findings demonstrate that no single fixed interval fits all executions. Healthy executions benefit from sparser checks that minimize disruption and token overhead, whereas compromised executions require tight supervision to prevent failure propagation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了四种不同的检查间隔，即 3、5、9 和 15 个步骤，并在图 1 中绘制了每个组别中解决率与检查间隔的关系图。 随着检查间隔的增加，两个组别的解决率呈现出相反的趋势。 对于执行健康状况受损的组别，较大的检查间隔会导致性能下降：解决率从检查间隔为 3 时的 23.87% 降至检查间隔为 15 时的 14.19%，降幅高达 9.68%。 相比之下，对于执行健康状况良好的组别，所有检查间隔设置下解决率始终保持较高水平，稳定在 88.28% 或以上。 同时，将检查间隔从 3 增加到 15 时，两个组别的令牌消耗量均单调减少：已解决的组别从 0.45M 令牌降至 0.30M 令牌，而未解决的组别从 0.70M 令牌降至 0.49M 令牌。 这些发现表明，没有任何一种固定的检查间隔适用于所有执行过程。 执行状况良好的任务能从更稀疏的检查中受益，因为这能最小化干扰和令牌开销；而执行状况受损的任务则需要严格的监督，以防止故障蔓延。

paragraphs.en: On SWE-bench Lite, 152 out of 300 tasks failed. Notably, 35 of these failed tasks never triggered guidance delivery even once, representing critical silent failures where the monitor remains deactivated. To understand why these failures were overlooked, two experts conducted an open coding ( Seaman, 1999 ) analysis of these trajectories, identifying three distinct categories of undetected misbehaviors (Figure 2 ). A wrong repair target means the agent identifies an incorrect code region for modification. An incorrect repair logic or implementation indicates that although the agent locates the correct code region, it introduces faulty logic or buggy code. An incomplete repair signifies that the agent only partially addresses the issue, leaving remaining bugs unresolved ( Gu et al., 2010 ) . These misbehaviors primarily reflect internal reasoning flaws rather than surface-level execution anomalies ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , making them inherently difficult for predefined rules to detect without inspecting the agent’s reasoning process.

paragraphs.en: This section introduces our framework for real-time agent monitoring and strategic guidance. We begin by defining the core problem formulation, establishing our goal of tracking agent health to deliver timely interventions that keep agents aligned with their task objectives. We then present an overview of Cadence, our overall monitoring system, detailing its high-level architecture and its two principal components. Next, we delve into the two-tier intervention module, which determines the depth and nature of corrective guidance. Finally, we describe the inspection scheduler, which optimizes the frequency and timing of agent evaluations to balance monitoring precision with computational efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍我们用于实时智能体监控和策略指导的框架。 我们首先定义核心问题表述，确立我们的目标：追踪智能体的状态，以便及时采取干预措施，确保智能体始终与任务目标保持一致。 接着，我们将概述 Cadence——我们的整体监控系统，并详细说明其高层架构及两个主要组成部分。 随后，我们将深入探讨双层干预模块，该模块负责确定纠正性指导的深度和性质。 最后，我们将描述检查调度器，它通过优化智能体评估的频率与时间，在监控精度与计算效率之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: Cadence consists of two modules: a two-tier intervention module and an inspection scheduler. The first module decides how to intervene, the second decides when to inspect, and together they provide strategic guidance. Specifically, the intervention module evaluates recent execution health and applies an appropriate intervention level, either advisory or replacement, to the current step. For normal execution or only minor lapses, an advisory-level intervention allows the step to execute while appending guidance to the trajectory for future steps. For severe misbehaviors, a replacement-level intervention discards the proposed step before execution and prompts the agent to regenerate it with the guidance. The inspection scheduler then uses this intervention level as an indicator of current execution health to adjust the inspection interval. This adaptive mechanism enables Cadence to back off during stable execution and intensify inspection during severe failures, preserving effectiveness while reducing monitoring overhead.
paragraphs.zh: Cadence 由两个模块组成：一个两级干预模块和一个检查调度器。 第一个模块决定如何干预，第二个模块决定何时进行检查，二者共同提供策略性指导。 具体来说，干预模块会评估近期的执行状态，并对当前步骤应用适当的干预级别，即建议级或替换级。 对于正常执行或仅存在轻微偏差的情况，建议级干预允许该步骤继续执行，同时为后续步骤在轨迹中附加指导信息。 对于严重的异常行为，替换级干预会在执行前丢弃所提议的步骤，并提示智能体根据指导信息重新生成该步骤。 随后，检查调度器会将此干预级别作为当前执行状态的指标，以调整检查间隔。 这种自适应机制使 Cadence 能够在稳定执行时降低检查频率，在严重故障时加强检查，从而在保持效果的同时减少监控开销。

paragraphs.en: The execution health of a coding agent manifests across distinct severity levels during task execution. A minor issue, such as an occasional tool misuse, often does not lead to task failure, since the agent can self-correct in the subsequent step based on environment feedback. In contrast, a severe mistake, such as repeatedly failing the same attempt, can significantly damage the execution workflow and lead to task failure. Therefore, a uniform intervention policy struggles to handle both. An overly aggressive strategy introduces unnecessary disruptions, and a permissive strategy lacks the efficacy to break the coding agent out of critical, compounding failure modes.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体的执行健康状况在任务执行过程中会呈现出不同严重程度的问题。 轻微问题，例如偶尔的工具误用，通常不会导致任务失败，因为智能体可以根据环境反馈在后续步骤中自我纠正。 相比之下，严重的错误，例如重复尝试同一操作却持续失败，可能会显著破坏执行流程并导致任务失败。 因此，统一的干预策略难以同时应对这两种情况。 过于激进的策略会引发不必要的干扰，而过于宽松的策略则缺乏将编码智能体从关键且不断累积的故障模式中解救出来的效果。

paragraphs.en: To address this trade-off, Cadence adaptively determines how to intervene according to execution health. Instead of relying on rigid, hard-coded rules, Cadence leverages LLM-based semantic reasoning to evaluate execution health and dynamically select intervention level, applying advisory guidance for satisfactory health and replacement actions for compromised health.

paragraphs.en: At each inspection, the module first invokes LLMs to evaluate the trajectory segment since the last inspection point, assign an appropriate intervention level and generate corresponding guidance text. Figure 4 illustrates the prompt used for this. Rather than using rigid and specific error patterns, we characterize execution health at a high conceptual level. Specifically, satisfactory execution health indicates that the coding agent is making steady progress toward resolving the issue, despite possible minor lapses in localized steps; compromised execution health signifies that the agent has drifted from the task goal, manifested by a persistent lack of progress or repeated failure modes. We deliberately avoid defining health through specific error types because different agents possess varying capabilities to resolve identical errors. Adopting high-level conceptual definitions thus enables Cadence to generalize across different coding agents.

paragraphs.en: Crucially, Cadence does not simply re-prompt a secondary LLM with the original failed problem. Instead, it uses task decomposition to reshape the problem representation ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ; Khot et al., 2023 ) . By decomposing a failing trajectory into localized execution health assessments, Cadence narrows the context window ( Liu et al., 2024 ) and restricts the search space, which can steer the monitor toward more reliable regions of its representation manifold. This decomposition also shifts the prompt in distribution. Long, multi-step error recovery trajectories are rare and noisy in pre-training data, while explicit diagnostic reasoning, such as analyzing code execution logs and troubleshooting steps, is heavily represented in standard corpora like StackOverflow Q&A threads and debugging forums. By converting an open-ended coding task into a structured execution health review, Cadence projects the problem onto a subspace where the monitor’s pre-trained prior is stronger. This decomposition is complementary to monitor capability rather than a substitute for it. Different LLM backbones also contribute to monitor performance, as our results for Section 5.2 show, because the decomposition changes what the monitor is asked to do, but it does not remove the need for a capable monitor.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，Cadence 并不会简单地用原始失败问题重新提示一个次要的 LLM。 相反，它通过任务分解来重塑问题的表示形式（Wei et al., 2022；Zhou et al., 2023；Khot et al., 2023）。 通过将失败的轨迹分解为局部执行健康评估，Cadence 缩小了上下文窗口（Liu et al., 2024），并限制了搜索空间，从而能够引导监控器朝向其表示流形中更可靠的区域。 这种分解也改变了提示的分布特征。 在预训练数据中，长且多步骤的错误恢复轨迹既罕见又充满噪声，而明确的诊断推理（例如分析代码执行日志和故障排除步骤）在 StackOverflow 问答线程和调试论坛等标准语料库中却大量存在。 通过将开放式的编码任务转化为结构化的执行健康审查，Cadence 将问题投影到一个子空间，使得监控器的预训练先验知识在此处更为有效。 这种分解是对监控器能力的补充，而非替代。 不同的 LLM 基础模型也会影响监控器的性能，正如我们在第 5.2 节的结果中所展示的那样，因为分解改变了监控器被要求执行的任务，但并未消除对高性能监控器的需求。

sents.zh: 在预训练数据中，长且多步骤的错误恢复轨迹既罕见又充满噪声，而明确的诊断推理（例如分析代码执行日志和故障排除步骤）在 StackOverflow 问答线程和调试论坛等标准语料库中却大量存在。

sents.en: By converting an open-ended coding task into a structured execution health review, Cadence projects the problem onto a subspace where the monitor’s pre-trained prior is stronger.
sents.zh: 通过将开放式的编码任务转化为结构化的执行健康审查，Cadence 将问题投影到一个子空间，使得监控器的预训练先验知识在此处更为有效。

sents.en: This decomposition is complementary to monitor capability rather than a substitute for it.
sents.zh: 这种分解是对监控器能力的补充，而非替代。

sents.en: Different LLM backbones also contribute to monitor performance, as our results for Section 5.2 show, because the decomposition changes what the monitor is asked to do, but it does not remove the need for a capable monitor.
sents.zh: 不同的 LLM 基础模型也会影响监控器的性能，正如我们在第 5.2 节的结果中所展示的那样，因为分解改变了监控器被要求执行的任务，但并未消除对高性能监控器的需求。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 illustrates the workflow of the two-tier intervention mechanism. At each inspection point, it examines the recent trajectory segments, alongside the thought and action proposed for the current step, prior to execution. Based on the monitor’s assessment, the module enforces one of two intervention policies. Under an advisory intervention, the proposed action is permitted to execute, after which the generated guidance is appended to the trajectory as a user message to guide subsequent steps. Under a replacement intervention, Cadence discards the proposed step and injects the guidance into the context and prompts the agent to regenerate the step, preventing catastrophic failure modes from compounding. Finally, the chosen intervention level serves as an execution health signal, passed to the scheduling module.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 展示了两级干预机制的工作流程。 在每个检查点，该机制会在执行前检查最近的轨迹片段，以及当前步骤所提出的思想和行动。 根据监控器的评估，该模块会强制执行两种干预策略之一。 在建议式干预下，允许执行所提议的行动，之后将生成的指导作为用户消息附加到轨迹中，以引导后续步骤。 在替换式干预下，Cadence 会丢弃所提议的步骤，并将指导注入上下文，然后提示智能体重新生成该步骤，从而防止灾难性故障模式进一步累积。 最后，所选的干预级别将作为执行健康状态信号，传递给调度模块。

paragraphs.en: Cadence’s scheduler dynamically changes the inspection interval based on the intervention module’s feedback ( Jacobson, 1988 ) , as formalized in Algorithm 1 . In the beginning, the module is configured with a base inspection interval I b ​ a ​ s ​ e I_{base} , a fixed growth step δ \delta , and a maximum inspection interval I m ​ a ​ x I_{max} that prevents the interval from growing so large that inspections effectively stop. During execution, an inspection is triggered whenever the agent completes I I steps since the last check. The scheduler then updates the interval according to the observed intervention level. When the intervention level is advisory, it indicates that the agent’s execution health is stable and only requires light guidance. In this case, the module increases the inspection interval by the growth step, capped at the maximum interval (i.e., I ← min ⁡ ( I + δ , I m ​ a ​ x ) I\leftarrow\min(I+\delta,I_{max}) ). When the intervention level is replacement, however, it indicates that the agent is misbehaving seriously during execution. The module then resets the inspection interval to the base value (i.e., I ← I b ​ a ​ s ​ e I\leftarrow I_{base} ), providing tighter supervision to guide the agent back on track. Through this adaptive scheduling mechanism, the scheduling module maintains inspection effectiveness while limiting unnecessary monitoring burden.
paragraphs.zh: Cadence 的调度器会根据干预模块的反馈动态调整检查间隔（Jacobson, 1988），如算法 1 中所形式化。 初始时，该模块被配置为具有一个基础检查间隔 I_{base}、一个固定的增长步长 δ，以及一个最大检查间隔 I_{max}，以防止检查间隔增长过大而导致检查实际上停止。 在执行过程中，每当智能体自上次检查以来完成 I 个步骤时，就会触发一次检查。 随后，调度器会根据观察到的干预级别更新检查间隔。 当干预级别为“建议”时，表示智能体的执行状态稳定，仅需轻度引导。 在这种情况下，模块会将检查间隔按增长步长增加，但上限为最大检查间隔（即 I←min(I+δ,I_{max})）。 然而，当干预级别为“替换”时，则表示智能体在执行过程中出现了严重异常行为。 此时，模块会将检查间隔重置为基础值（即 I←I_{base}），以更严格的监督引导智能体重回正轨。 通过这种自适应调度机制，调度模块能够在保持检查有效性的同时，限制不必要的监控负担。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Cadence by answering the following research questions (RQs):
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过回答以下研究问题（RQs）来评估 Cadence：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How effective and efficient is Cadence compared with existing runtime monitors?
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1：与现有的运行时监控器相比，Cadence 的有效性和效率如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: How robust is Cadence across different backbone models and scheduling parameters?
paragraphs.zh: 问题2：Cadence 在不同骨干模型和调度参数下的鲁棒性如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: How does each module contribute to the performance of Cadence?
paragraphs.zh: 问题3：每个模块如何对 Cadence 的性能做出贡献？

paragraphs.en: RQ4: When does Cadence succeed, and when does it fall short?
paragraphs.zh: 问题4：Cadence 何时成功，又何时会失败？

paragraphs.en: We conduct our experiments on SWE-bench Lite ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , a benchmark of 300 issues collected from popular open-source Python repositories on GitHub and widely used to evaluate coding agents. Each issue provides a task description, a base commit, and a set of tests. These tests fall into two groups. FAIL_TO_PASS tests fail on the base commit and should pass once the issue is resolved. PASS_TO_PASS tests already pass on the base commit and should remain passing afterwards. Given the task description, the coding agent runs on the repository at the base commit and produces a patch. An issue is resolved only if all tests in both groups pass after applying the patch, indicating it fixes the issue without introducing regressions ( Smith et al., 2015 ; Goues et al., 2012 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SWE-bench Lite（Jimenez 等人，2024）上开展实验。这是一个基准测试，包含从 GitHub 上流行的开源 Python 仓库中收集的 300 个问题，并广泛用于评估编码智能体。 每个问题都提供任务描述、一个基础提交以及一组测试。 这些测试分为两组。 FAIL_TO_PASS 测试在基础提交上会失败，但在问题解决后应通过。 PASS_TO_PASS 测试在基础提交上已通过，并且之后应保持通过状态。 根据任务描述，编码智能体会在基础提交的仓库上运行并生成一个补丁。 只有在应用补丁后两组所有测试都通过时，问题才算解决，这表明该补丁修复了问题而未引入回归（Smith 等人，2015；Goues 等人，2012）。

paragraphs.en: We compare Cadence against three monitoring baselines covering both periodic guidance and rule-based guidance described in Section 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Cadence 与三种监控基线方法进行了比较，这些方法涵盖了第 1 节中描述的周期性指导和基于规则的指导。

paragraphs.en: Fixed-Interval ( k k ) represents periodic guidance. Every fixed k k steps, it pauses the coding agent, invokes an LLM to inspect the recent trajectory, and appends the resulting guidance into the coding agent’s context. This design is a synchronous version of Wink ( Nanda et al., 2026 ) . Original Wink ( Nanda et al., 2026 ) allows the coding agent to continue executing while it generates guidance in the background. Once finished, Wink appends the guidance to the current context. Because guidance generation speed and coding agent execution speed vary with LLM delays, this asynchronous design causes the guidance to be injected at unpredictable execution steps. We adopt a synchronous design to eliminate LLM latency as a confounding variable, ensuring a fair evaluation of intervention timing.
paragraphs.zh: 固定间隔（k k）代表周期性的指导。 每经过固定的 k k 步，系统就会暂停编码智能体，调用一个大语言模型来检查最近的执行轨迹，并将生成的指导信息添加到编码智能体的上下文中。 这种设计是 Wink（Nanda 等人，2026）的同步版本。 原始 Wink（Nanda 等人，2026）允许编码智能体在后台生成指导的同时继续执行。 生成完成后，Wink 会将指导信息添加到当前上下文中。 由于指导生成的速度和编码智能体的执行速度会因大语言模型的延迟而不同，这种异步设计导致指导信息会在不可预测的执行步骤中被注入。 我们采用同步设计来消除大语言模型延迟这一干扰变量，从而确保对干预时机的公平评估。

paragraphs.en: LivePlan ( Liu et al., 2026 ) represents rule-based guidance. It maps coding agent actions into predefined workflow phases and tracks state transitions using an execution graph. When predefined rules detect state anomalies, such as phase stalling or action loops, an LLM is prompted to generate targeted guidance. Depending on anomaly severity, LivePlan either blocks the erroneous step to force a regeneration with guidance, or simply appends guidance to context for subsequent steps.
paragraphs.zh: LivePlan（Liu 等人，2026）体现了基于规则的引导方式。 它将编码智能体的动作映射到预定义的工作流程阶段，并通过执行图来追踪状态转换。 当预定义规则检测到状态异常时，例如阶段停滞或动作循环，会提示 LLM 生成针对性的引导。 根据异常的严重程度，LivePlan 要么阻止错误步骤以强制在引导下重新生成，要么直接将引导附加到上下文中供后续步骤使用。

Instead, each rule has a fixed guidance message written in advance, which the monitor returns whenever that rule fires. This baseline shows how well the coding agent performs with general guidance that is not tailored to its current situation.

paragraphs.en: Additionally, we include Vanilla , the standalone agent without monitoring, as a control baseline to quantify the net benefits brought by monitoring.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们将无监控的独立智能体 Vanilla 作为对照基线，以量化监控所带来的净收益。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether monitors generalize across coding agent scaffolds, we evaluate the monitors on two representative coding agents that manage actions differently.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验监控器能否在不同编码智能体框架中实现泛化，我们在两种具有代表性的编码智能体上对监控器进行了评估，这两种智能体以不同的方式管理操作。

paragraphs.en: mini-swe-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) exposes only the bash command to the model. Every operation, such as reading files and editing code, is written as a shell command. Each command runs in a new subshell, so changes to the working directory or to environment variables do not carry over to later steps. The agent submits its solution by producing a git diff of the files.
paragraphs.zh: mini-swe-agent（Yang 等人，2024）仅向模型暴露 bash 命令。 所有操作，例如读取文件和编辑代码，都以 shell 命令的形式编写。 每个命令都在一个新的子 shell 中运行，因此工作目录或环境变量中的更改不会传递到后续步骤。 该智能体通过生成文件的 git diff 来提交其解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Moatless ( Antoniades et al., 2025 ) instead exposes a set of 11 structured tools that cover search, file reading, editing, test execution, and task completion. Before the run, Moatless builds a vector index of the repository with a code embedding model. The agent can then call SemanticSearch to locate relevant code with a natural language query, instead of relying on exact text matching. In the end, Moatless invokes either VerifiedFinish to submit the patch, or Reject to report that the issue cannot be resolved.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of Cadence’s effectiveness and efficiency against all baselines, using Gemini-2.5-Flash as the coding agent backbone model and GPT-5.2 as the monitor backbone model. Since GPT-5.2 is a reasoning model and does not support a temperature setting, we instead leave its reasoning effort at the default medium level. Regarding baseline configurations, prior studies typically adopt a fixed interval of 5 steps for the Fixed-Interval baseline. To ensure a thorough comparison and avoid biasing the baseline with a single interval choice, we also evaluate intervals of 3 and 7 steps.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports the main results. Cadence achieves the highest resolve rate across both coding agents. Specifically, it outperforms the strongest baseline on each agent, improving task resolution over LivePlan by 4.33% (+13 tasks) on Moatless and over Fixed-Interval ( k = 5 k=5 ) by 8.33% (+25 tasks) on mini-swe-agent. Compared with the Vanilla baseline, Cadence achieves absolute gains of 15.67% on Moatless and 25.33% on mini-swe-agent. As shown in Figure 6 , Cadence solves the most unique tasks on both agents, with 17 on Moatless and 20 on mini-swe-agent. Qualitative analysis shows that these uniquely resolved tasks are primarily rescued from incomplete repairs and incorrect bug root cause locations. The resolution of these complex misbehaviors benefits from Cadence leveraging LLM reasoning to track the agent’s intent and evaluate its code modifications at appropriate frequency.

paragraphs.en: To further verify that these improvements are not attributable to chance, we conduct two-sided exact McNemar tests on the paired task-level resolution states, with Holm ( Holm, 1979 ) correction across all baseline comparisons. The result shows that Cadence significantly outperforms all baselines on both coding agents except LivePlan on Moatless, where the adjusted p p -value is 0.1175. This insignificance can be partially attributed to the distinct action spaces of the two agents. mini-swe-agent relies on flexible bash commands, making it harder for LivePlan to map actions to predefined misbehavior patterns accurately, where Cadence outperforms LivePlan by a larger margin of 15.67%. Conversely, Moatless uses 11 structured tools with clearly defined functions, enabling more reliable mapping for LivePlan and narrowing the margin to 4.33%. Even in this constrained setting, Cadence still achieves a higher resolve rate while maintaining superior token leverage (0.83 versus 0.69).
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步验证这些改进并非偶然，我们对成对的任务级解决状态进行了双侧精确 McNemar 检验，并在所有基线比较中应用了 Holm（Holm, 1979）校正。 结果表明，在 Moatless 数据集上，除 LivePlan 外，Cadence 在所有编码智能体中的表现均显著优于所有基线模型，其调整后的 p 值为 0.1175。 这种不显著性部分归因于两种智能体不同的动作空间。mini-swe-agent 依赖灵活的 bash 命令，这使得 LivePlan 更难将动作准确映射到预定义的不良行为模式；而在此场景下，Cadence 比 LivePlan 的表现优势更大，差距达到 15.67%。 相反，Moatless 使用了 11 个功能明确的结构化工具，这使 LivePlan 能够更可靠地进行动作映射，从而将差距缩小至 4.33%。 即使在这种受限的设置下，Cadence 仍然实现了更高的解决率，同时保持了更优的令牌利用率（0.83 对比 0.69）。

paragraphs.en: Alongside its effectiveness, Cadence also achieves efficiency gains. On mini-swe-agent, Cadence consumes the fewest tokens per task and yields the highest token leverage. This advantage stems from two primary design choices. First, Cadence extends the inspection interval when execution is healthy, thereby reducing monitoring overhead and keeping LLM invocation frequency second only to LivePlan, which triggers the LLM solely when heuristic rules fire. Second, empowered by LLMs, Cadence identifies a broader spectrum of misbehaviors and applies fine-grained interventions tailored to error severity, rescuing tasks that other baselines miss or mismanage. Consequently, Cadence resolves significantly more tasks for equivalent token expenditures, maximizing its overall token leverage. A similar trend holds on Moatless, where Cadence also achieves the top token leverage while maintaining average token consumption per task comparable to the strongest baseline, LivePlan (0.48M versus 0.51M).

paragraphs.en: In this section, we investigate whether Cadence’s performance advantages depend on specific system configurations. paragraphs.en: Table 4 summarizes the scheduling ablation results. For k = 7 k=7 , the agent uses nearly the same token budget (1.025 versus 1.028 million tokens per task) as full Cadence with a similar inspection frequency (5.07 versus 5.90 invocations per task), yet its resolve rate drops by 9.00%. This indicates that strategic inspection timing is crucial when monitoring overhead is held constant. Furthermore, setting k = 5 k=5 provides more monitoring resources, increasing inspections per task by 36.10% and tokens per task by 17.03% compared with full Cadence, yet yields virtually no resolution gain (42.00% versus 42.33%). This demonstrates that additional monitoring resources may fail to improve performance if inspection points are not carefully selected. Further increasing monitoring density with k = 3 k=3 provides the most abundant resources among all fixed variants, more than doubling the inspection invocations of full Cadence (12.45 versus 5.90). This setting raises the resolve rate by 3.33%. However, this minor improvement is not statistically significant according to McNemar’s test ( p = 0.24 p=0.24 ). Moreover, k = 3 k=3 consumes 15.00% more tokens and lowers token leverage by 6.30% compared to full Cadence. These findings show that while heavy monitoring can slightly raise the resolve rate, its token efficiency still lags behind full Cadence. This confirms the core value of our dynamic scheduling module, which aims to allocate monitoring resources more effectively toward the steps where the agent needs them most.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 4 , resolve rates drop for both the always-advisory and always-replacement variants (by 7.33% and 4.33%, respectively) compared to the full Cadence, demonstrating that a single intervention strategy cannot adequately handle all execution states. In addition, the always-advisory variant exhibits longer average task steps and consumes 12.2% more tokens than the always-replacement variant. This increase occurs partly because advisory interventions only provide guidance without directly interrupting the coding agent. Consequently, when an action introduces flawed code or deletes critical files, the agent requires additional steps to remediate the mistake, whereas replacement interventions directly halt erroneous actions and trigger immediate regeneration in a single step.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 4 所示，与完整的 Cadence 相比，“始终建议”和“始终替换”两种变体的解决率均有所下降（分别下降 7.33% 和 4.33%），这表明单一干预策略无法充分应对所有执行状态。 此外，“始终建议”变体的平均任务步骤更长，且比“始终替换”变体多消耗 12.2% 的令牌。 这种增加部分原因在于，建议类干预仅提供指导，而不会直接中断编码智能体。 因此，当某个操作引入有缺陷的代码或删除关键文件时，智能体需要额外步骤来纠正错误；而替换类干预则能直接阻止错误操作，并在单一步骤中立即触发重新生成。

sents.zh: 此外，“始终建议”变体的平均任务步骤更长，且比“始终替换”变体多消耗 12.2% 的令牌。

sents.en: This increase occurs partly because advisory interventions only provide guidance without directly interrupting the coding agent.
sents.zh: 这种增加部分原因在于，建议类干预仅提供指导，而不会直接中断编码智能体。

sents.en: Consequently, when an action introduces flawed code or deletes critical files, the agent requires additional steps to remediate the mistake, whereas replacement interventions directly halt erroneous actions and trigger immediate regeneration in a single step.
sents.zh: 因此，当某个操作引入有缺陷的代码或删除关键文件时，智能体需要额外步骤来纠正错误；而替换类干预则能直接阻止错误操作，并在单一步骤中立即触发重新生成。

paragraphs.en: To establish the operational scope of Cadence, we analyze its execution trajectories from the RQ1 experiments across both mini-swe-agent and Moatless. We evaluate the resolved and failed cases independently through case level examination. For resolved cases requiring intervention, we categorize the specific misbehaviors that Cadence corrects. For failed cases, we investigate the root failure mechanisms that constrain current monitor performance.

paragraphs.en: Two experts independently evaluated all 246 resolved cases to identify instances containing critical monitor interventions, defined as cases where the coding agent exhibited a misbehavior that would likely lead to task failure without monitor correction. This labeling achieved a Cohen’s kappa of 0.94 ( Cohen, 1960 ; Landis and Koch, 1977 ) , leaving 112 critical cases after resolving discrepancies through discussion, while the remaining 134 cases succeeded with auxiliary guidance that merely reinforced correct agent execution. Crucially, 90 of these 112 cases (80.4%) failed under the vanilla agent setup, corroborating the necessity of monitor intervention for task resolution.

paragraphs.en: To analyze the misbehaviors addressed by Cadence, the two experts further performed a joint deductive-inductive ( Cruzes and Dyba, 2011 ; Fereday and Muir‐Cochrane, 2006 ) coding process on these 112 cases. They first mapped misbehaviors to existing categories from Section 2.2 , and applied open coding to instances outside those definitions, yielding one new category termed tool-use error . This category represents cases where the agent intends a valid code modification but fails during improper tool invocations, such as an edit command that silently fails or introduces syntax errors into the target file.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 7 , CADENCE effectively resolves both reasoning and tool use errors. Among these 112 corrected cases, replacement guidance serves as the decisive intervention in 88 cases (78.6%), while advisory guidance resolves the remaining 24 cases (21.4%), demonstrating the practical value of both intervention levels. Reasoning errors constitute the majority (72.3%) of corrected misbehaviors, proving that detecting non-deterministic reasoning flaws is essential for trajectory monitoring. Tool use errors account for the remaining 27.7%, occurring almost exclusively under mini-swe-agent (29 of 31 cases) because its free-form shell environment is inherently more error prone than Moatless’s structured editing tools.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 7 所示，CADENCE 能有效解决推理和工具使用两类错误。 在这 112 个被纠正的案例中，替换引导在 88 个案例（78.6%）中发挥了决定性干预作用，而建议引导则解决了其余 24 个案例（21.4%），这表明两种干预层级都具有实际价值。 推理错误占被纠正的异常行为的多数（72.3%），这证明检测非确定性的推理缺陷对于轨迹监控至关重要。 工具使用错误占其余 27.7%，几乎全部发生在 mini-swe-agent 中（31 个案例中的 29 个），因为其自由形式的 shell 环境本质上比 Moatless 的结构化编辑工具更容易出错。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 illustrates how Cadence redirects a coding agent facing an incorrect repair target issue. In this task, the goal is to ensure that deleting a model instance without dependencies properly clears its primary key. Django implements deletion via two paths: a standard path and a fast path. During execution, the agent mistakenly added the clearing logic to the standard path, whereas models without dependencies actually trigger the fast path. Upon inspecting the agent’s proposed submission, Cadence identified this mismatch and blocked the action, preventing a flawed patch from being submitted. Cadence then applied replacement guidance, discarding the submission and instructing the agent to implement the logic within the fast path instead. Guided by this intervention, the agent successfully modified the fast path and resolved the issue, whereas the baseline agent submitted an invalid patch that failed to satisfy the task requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 展示了 Cadence 如何引导一个遇到错误修复目标问题的编码智能体进行方向调整。 在此任务中，目标是确保删除一个没有依赖关系的模型实例时，能够正确清除其主键。 Django 通过两种路径实现删除操作：标准路径和快速路径。 在执行过程中，该智能体错误地将清除逻辑添加到了标准路径中，而实际上没有依赖关系的模型会触发快速路径。 在检查该智能体提出的提交方案时，Cadence 发现了这一不匹配问题并阻止了该操作，从而防止了错误补丁的提交。 随后，Cadence 应用了替换指导，丢弃了该提交方案，并指示智能体转而将逻辑实现到快速路径中。 在该干预措施的指导下，智能体成功修改了快速路径并解决了问题，而基准智能体则提交了一个无效的补丁，未能满足任务要求。

paragraphs.en: We examine all failure cases from RQ1, excluding those caused by step budget exhaustion, leaving 284 cases for analysis. To systematically analyze these remaining failures, we first attribute each failure to either the coding agent or the monitor based on its primary root cause. A failure is attributed to the coding agent only when the monitor provides timely and correct guidance that the agent fails to carry out; all other cases are attributed to the monitor. Two authors with over two years of agent development experience independently perform this attribution, achieving a Cohen’s kappa of 0.98. After mapping each case to its responsible party, we apply open coding in two stages to derive failure categories. First, the two authors jointly analyze a random sample of 100 cases, label each with a brief cause description, and iteratively merge similar labels until no new categories emerge. Second, the authors independently assign the remaining cases to these established categories, reaching a Cohen’s kappa of 0.92. All disagreements in both stages are resolved through discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检查了 RQ1 中的所有失败案例，排除了因步骤预算耗尽而导致的案例，最终留下 284 个案例进行分析。 为了系统性地分析这些剩余的失败案例，我们首先根据每个失败的主要根本原因，将其归因于编码智能体或监控智能体。 只有当监控智能体提供了及时且正确的指导，而编码智能体未能执行时，该失败才会被归因于编码智能体；所有其他情况均归因于监控智能体。 两位拥有超过两年智能体开发经验的作者独立进行了这一归因分析，最终达成 0.98 的 Cohen’s kappa 值。 在将每个案例映射到其责任方之后，我们通过两阶段开放编码法来提取失败类别。 首先，两位作者共同分析了 100 个随机抽取的案例样本，为每个案例标注简要的原因描述，并迭代合并相似的标签，直到不再出现新的类别。 其次，两位作者独立地将剩余案例分配至这些已建立的类别中，最终达成 0.92 的 Cohen’s kappa 值。 两个阶段中的所有分歧均通过讨论解决。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 summarizes the distribution of these failure categories. Both the monitor and the coding agent contribute substantially to total failures (57.7% versus 42.3%). Among monitor failures, Root-Cause Misdiagnosis is the most prevalent category (26.8%), encompassing instances where the monitor either identifies an incorrect defect location or focuses solely on a superficial cause. Inaccurate Guidance Generation (22.9%) refers to cases where the monitor locates the root cause accurately, but delivers either a logic-flawed repair strategy or an overly abstract guidance plan. Inspection Timing Failure accounts for 8.1% of cases, where short execution tasks finish before the first inspection triggers. This issue occurs exclusively on Moatless because it executes multiple tool calls in a single turn, which greatly compresses total trajectory steps. For coding agent failures, Incomplete Guidance Realization forms the largest overall category (39.4%), representing cases where the agent accepts valid guidance but strays from the prescribed plan during multi-step execution. Finally, Guidance Non-Compliance is rare (2.8%), describing scenarios where the coding agent remains entirely uninfluenced by the delivered guidance, showing no adjustment in its reasoning or actions.
paragraphs.zh: 表5总结了这些故障类别的分布情况。 监控智能体和编码智能体对总故障均有显著贡献（分别为57.7%和42.3%）。 在监控智能体的故障中，根本原因误诊是最常见的类别（占26.8%），包括监控智能体错误识别缺陷位置或仅关注表面原因的情况。 不准确的指导生成（占22.9%）指的是监控智能体虽然准确定位了根本原因，但提供的修复策略存在逻辑缺陷，或给出的指导计划过于抽象。 检查时机故障占8.1%，即执行任务结束时间早于首次检查触发之时。 该问题仅出现在Moatless中，因为它在单个回合内执行多次工具调用，从而大幅压缩了总轨迹步数。 在编码智能体的故障中，指导实现不完整是总体最大的类别（占39.4%），指智能体虽然接受了有效指导，但在多步骤执行过程中偏离了既定计划的情况。 最后，指导不遵从的情况较为罕见（占2.8%），指的是编码智能体完全不受所提供指导的影响，其推理或行动均未出现任何调整的情形。

paragraphs.en: These empirical findings point to three concrete directions for improving Cadence. First, to mitigate Inspection Timing Failure, the monitoring framework can incorporate tool invocation counts alongside step bounds when determining inspection timing for agents that bundle multiple actions per turn. Second, to address Root-Cause Misdiagnosis and Inaccurate Guidance Generation, prompt designs can be refined to encourage deeper root-cause reasoning; enforcing the monitor to thoroughly investigate underlying execution states rather than stopping at superficial symptoms can improve both diagnostic accuracy and the quality of generated guidance. Third, to address Incomplete Guidance Realization, the monitor can maintain an explicit checklist of raised issues to actively track resolution progress, gating final submissions until all flagged defects are fully addressed.
paragraphs.zh: 这些实证研究结果为改进 Cadence 指明了三个具体方向。 首先，为了缓解“检查时机失败”问题，在确定每次行动回合中执行多个动作的智能体的检查时机时，监控框架可以将工具调用次数与步骤限制一并纳入考量。 其次，为了解决“根本原因误诊”和“指导生成不准确”的问题，可以优化提示词设计，以鼓励更深入的根因推理；通过强制监控器彻底调查底层执行状态，而非仅停留在表面症状层面，可以提升诊断准确性以及所生成指导的质量。 第三，为了解决“指导实现不完整”的问题，监控器可以维护一份已提出问题的明确清单，主动跟踪解决进度，并在所有标记出的缺陷完全解决之前阻止最终提交。

paragraphs.en: Internal Threat. Internal threats to validity mainly involve three aspects. First, to mitigate the randomness inherent in LLMs, we set the generation temperature to 0 whenever supported while leaving other settings at their defaults, and perform statistical significance testing on the main results. Second, to guarantee fair baseline comparisons, we utilize the official public implementations when available or re-implement the methods strictly following their original papers. Third, manual annotations during qualitative categorizations may introduce human subjectivity. To mitigate this threat, all trajectory misbehaviors and failure categories are determined by two annotators, with all discrepancies resolved through discussion.

paragraphs.en: External Threat. External threats to validity mainly involve two aspects. First, our evaluation focuses on bug fixing and feature implementation tasks in Python, whereas coding agents can also handle other kinds of tasks, such as test generation, and tasks in other programming languages. In the future, we plan to evaluate CADENCE on additional benchmarks, such as SWT-bench ( Mündler et al., 2024 ) and SWE-bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , to further assess its generalizability. paragraphs.en: Existing methods for enhancing coding agents primarily fall into two categories: offline learning and online monitoring. In the following, we review related works under both categories.
paragraphs.zh: 现有用于增强编码智能体的方法主要可分为两类：离线学习和在线监控。 接下来，我们将回顾这两类方法的相关研究。

sents.en: Existing methods for enhancing coding agents primarily fall into two categories: offline learning and online monitoring.
sents.zh: 现有用于增强编码智能体的方法主要可分为两类：离线学习和在线监控。

sents.en: In the following, we review related works under both categories.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将回顾这两类方法的相关研究。

paragraphs.en: Offline learning relies on historical execution records to enhance coding agents, primarily through model post-training or prompt-based experience reuse. Wei et al. ( Wei et al., 2025 ) pioneered the use of reinforcement learning in coding agents by introducing SWE-RL, which fine-tunes the backbone model using rewards based on similarity to ground-truth patches. In addition, SWE-GYM ( Pan et al., 2025a ) leverages powerful LLMs to perform coding tasks and uses the generated trajectories to train smaller models via imitation learning. For experience reuse in prompts, Wang et al. ( Wang et al., 2025b ) proposed Agent Workflow Memory, which extracts common workflows from past trajectories and integrates them into system prompts. Chen et al. ( Chen et al., 2026a ) introduced SWE-Exp, which distills experiences from both successful and failed trajectories into a knowledge base and retrieves those relevant to a new task. However, these offline methods cannot handle runtime misbehaviors interactively; online monitoring fills this gap by providing real-time guidance during execution.
paragraphs.zh: 离线学习依赖历史执行记录来增强编码智能体，主要通过模型后训练或基于提示的经验复用实现。Wei 等人 （Wei 等人，2025）率先在编码智能体中应用强化学习，提出了 SWE-RL，该方法利用与真实代码片段相似性相关的奖励对骨干模型进行微调。 此外，SWE-GYM（Pan 等人，2025a）借助强大的 LLM 执行编码任务，并利用生成的轨迹通过模仿学习训练较小的模型。 在提示中的经验复用方面，Wang 等人 （Wang 等人，2025b）提出了“智能体工作流记忆”，该方法从过往轨迹中提取常见的工作流，并将其整合到系统提示中。Chen 等人 （Chen 等人，2026a）引入了 SWE-Exp，该方法将成功和失败轨迹中的经验提炼到知识库中，并在执行新任务时检索相关经验。 然而，这些离线方法无法交互式地处理运行时的异常行为；在线监控通过在执行过程中提供实时指导填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: Online monitoring inspects runtime execution trajectories and delivers guidance upon detecting misbehaviors. Existing approaches fall into two categories based on their guidance triggering mechanisms: rule-based guidance and periodic guidance.

paragraphs.en: Rule-based guidance predefines targeted misbehaviors and models specific misbehavior patterns over the agent’s action space. A representative approach is LivePlan ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , which maps agent actions to predefined workflow phases to detect skipped or stalled execution phases. Additionally, LivePlan tracks execution trajectories using an action-graph representation to detect action loops. Upon matching patterns for severe misbehaviors, such as action loops or unauthorized phase skipping, LivePlan blocks the proposed action and invokes an LLM to generate guidance, prompting the agent to produce a new action. Conversely, for minor misbehaviors, it merely appends guidance to the trajectory upon the current step completion.
paragraphs.zh: 基于规则的引导会预先定义目标不当行为，并在智能体的动作空间中建模特定的不当行为模式。 一种典型的方法是 LivePlan（Liu 等人，2026），它将智能体的动作映射到预定义的流程阶段，以检测被跳过或停滞的执行阶段。 此外，LivePlan 还通过动作图表示法追踪执行轨迹，以检测动作循环。 一旦匹配到严重不当行为的模式（例如动作循环或未授权的阶段跳过），LivePlan 会阻止所提议的动作，并调用 LLM 生成引导，促使智能体产生新的动作。 相反，对于轻微的不当行为，它只是在当前步骤完成时向轨迹中添加引导信息。

However, heuristic rules fail to detect complex reasoning errors that require natural language understanding. Moreover, because each agent possesses a distinct action space, LivePlan requires manual adjustments to its action-phase mappings when deployed on a new agent.
paragraphs.zh: 通过基于启发式的检查，LivePlan 借助模式匹配实现了快速且精确的异常行为检测。 然而，启发式规则无法检测出需要自然语言理解的复杂推理错误。 此外，由于每个智能体都具有不同的动作空间，当 LivePlan 部署到新的智能体上时，需要手动调整其动作阶段的映射关系。

By exploiting the natural language understanding and domain knowledge of LLMs, such inspection can identify complex reasoning errors beyond the reach of heuristic rules. Furthermore, directly analyzing raw trajectory text independent of the agent’s action space provides better generalizability across diverse coding agents. To keep cost under control, such monitors typically invoke LLM-based inspection periodically.

paragraphs.en: A representative approach is Wink ( Nanda et al., 2026 ) . It invokes an LLM to inspect the execution trajectory at fixed step intervals. To mitigate the latency associated with frequent LLM calls, it performs inspections asynchronously, allowing the agent to continue execution without waiting for inspection results. Guidance is injected into the trajectory only when misbehavior is detected. Although this asynchronous design reduces runtime delays, a severe misbehavior may rapidly cascade into an unrecoverable failure while the agent continues executing before the inspection completes. More fundamentally, the inspection interval in Wink is statically predetermined and remains indifferent to the agent’s real-time execution status. Consequently, a healthy agent and a misbehaving agent receive the same frequency of supervision, which represents a sub-optimal design choice as demonstrated by our motivating study (Section 2.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一种代表性的方法是 Wink（Nanda 等人，2026）。 它会调用一个大语言模型，在固定的步骤间隔内检查执行轨迹。 为了减轻频繁调用大语言模型所带来的延迟，该方法以异步方式进行检查，使智能体无需等待检查结果即可继续执行。 只有在检测到异常行为时，才会向执行轨迹注入引导信息。 尽管这种异步设计减少了运行时延迟，但如果出现严重的异常行为，它可能会迅速演变为不可恢复的故障，而智能体在检查完成前仍会继续执行。 更根本的是，Wink 中的检查间隔是静态预定的，并且与智能体的实时执行状态无关。 因此，正常运行的智能体和存在异常行为的智能体获得了相同频率的监督，正如我们的动机研究（第 2.1 节）所示，这是一种次优的设计选择。

sents.en: It invokes an LLM to inspect the execution trajectory at fixed step intervals.
sents.zh: 它会调用一个大语言模型，在固定的步骤间隔内检查执行轨迹。

sents.en: To mitigate the latency associated with frequent LLM calls, it performs inspections asynchronously, allowing the agent to continue execution without waiting for inspection results.
sents.zh: 为了减轻频繁调用大语言模型所带来的延迟，该方法以异步方式进行检查，使智能体无需等待检查结果即可继续执行。

sents.en: Guidance is injected into the trajectory only when misbehavior is detected.
sents.zh: 只有在检测到异常行为时，才会向执行轨迹注入引导信息。

sents.en: Although this asynchronous design reduces runtime delays, a severe misbehavior may rapidly cascade into an unrecoverable failure while the agent continues executing before the inspection completes.
sents.zh: 尽管这种异步设计减少了运行时延迟，但如果出现严重的异常行为，它可能会迅速演变为不可恢复的故障，而智能体在检查完成前仍会继续执行。

sents.en: More fundamentally, the inspection interval in Wink is statically predetermined and remains indifferent to the agent’s real-time execution status.
sents.zh: 更根本的是，Wink 中的检查间隔是静态预定的，并且与智能体的实时执行状态无关。

sents.en: Consequently, a healthy agent and a misbehaving agent receive the same frequency of supervision, which represents a sub-optimal design choice as demonstrated by our motivating study (Section 2.1 ).
sents.zh: 因此，正常运行的智能体和存在异常行为的智能体获得了相同频率的监督，正如我们的动机研究（第 2.1 节）所示，这是一种次优的设计选择。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose Cadence, a dynamic runtime monitor for coding agents that integrates a two-tier intervention module with an inspection scheduler. The intervention module provides advisory guidance when agent execution health remains satisfactory, while issuing replacement guidance when severe misbehaviors occur. Based on the resulting intervention level, the scheduler dynamically adjusts the inspection frequency, increasing supervision for replacement-level cases and reducing it for advisory-level ones. Evaluation on 300 SWE-bench Lite tasks across two coding agents shows that Cadence achieves the highest resolve rate among all evaluated monitors while maintaining competitive token efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 Cadence——一种面向编码智能体的动态运行时监控器，它将双层级干预模块与检查调度器相结合。 当智能体执行状态保持良好时，干预模块会提供建议性指导；而当出现严重异常行为时，则会发出替换指导。 根据由此确定的干预级别，调度器会动态调整检查频率：对需要替换级别的案例增加监督，而对建议级别的案例则减少监督。 在两个编码智能体上针对 300 个 SWE-bench Lite 任务进行的评估表明，Cadence 在所有受测监控器中实现了最高的解决率，同时保持了具有竞争力的令牌效率。
